title: Maximal-localization criterion for the Ext projective-dimension bound
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $M$ be a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and let $d\geq0$ be an integer. Write $\mathrm{PD}_{\leq d}(M)$ for the predicate that $\operatorname{Ext}_R^i(M,N)=0$ for every $R$-module $N$ and every integer $i\geq d+1$ [def-pc-ext]. For a maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ put $R_{\mathfrak m}=(R\setminus\mathfrak m)^{-1}R$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and $M_{\mathfrak m}=(R\setminus\mathfrak m)^{-1}M$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization], and define the same predicate over $R_{\mathfrak m}$ using all $R_{\mathfrak m}$-modules. Then $$\mathrm{PD}_{\leq d}(M)\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\mathrm{PD}_{\leq d}(M_{\mathfrak m})\text{ for every maximal ideal }\mathfrak m\subset R.$$ This includes $M=0$, $R=0$, and $d=0$.
